name: Siegfried Mureşan, Carla Tavares - § 2 - Am 50
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 55p. Underlines the need to combat digital exclusion in the area of justice; calls for young people, elderly people, people with disabilities and people in vulnerable situations to receive tailored assistance, including through simplified digital tools and accessible information;
